records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue from subscriptions and returns represented 91% of total revenue in 2021 and 93% of total revenue in 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue from subscription and returns comprised approximately 91% of our revenue for 2021 compared to 93% of our revenue for 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our business continued to be impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic during 2021, which over the last two years has resulted in authorities implementing numerous preventative measures to contain or mitigate the extent of the impact, including travel bans and restrictions, limitations on business activity, quarantines, and shelter-in-place orders.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We maintained a total gross margin of 71% in 2021, despite an increase in the proportion of revenue generated from professional services, which has a lower gross margin.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating loss was $106.6 million during 2021 compared to an operating loss of $62.0 million during 2020.
